answer: Admission is an auction at the epoch jetty: newcomers bid POA for one of 50 slots, the top 50 win and losers are refunded. Each winning bid is carved on the cedar board and locked 20 epochs as a bond, slashed if the identity clones itself. At a 40 POA clearing price, 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA per epoch and lose bonds when caught, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its vertex in the funding graph, and is refunded after 20 honest epochs.
